# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: All-agent company order desk
version: "1.0"
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1800
tools:
  - name: sales_record
    type: cli
    description: Read the fixed local sales record. Takes no arguments.
    command: "python3 -I order_desk.py sales"
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits: {timeout_sec: 10}
  - name: operations_record
    type: cli
    description: Read the fixed local operations record. Takes no arguments.
    command: "python3 -I order_desk.py operations"
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits: {timeout_sec: 10}
  - name: finance_record
    type: cli
    description: Read the fixed local finance record. Takes no arguments.
    command: "python3 -I order_desk.py finance"
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits: {timeout_sec: 10}
agents:
  - name: Sales
    role: worker
    tools: [sales_record]
    system_prompt: "Summarize the customer order and constraints."
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
  - name: Operations
    role: worker
    tools: [operations_record]
    system_prompt: "Compare supply options with the requested delivery date and report the shortage."
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
  - name: Finance
    role: worker
    tools: [finance_record]
    system_prompt: "Apply the policy tool. Relay its exact decision, price options and blockers."
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
  - name: CustomerSuccess
    role: worker
    system_prompt: "Draft a short reply for the customer based on the Finance result. Omit all numerical details. On HOLD, ask whether timing or budget is flexible. Do not promise fulfillment or claim any purchase was made."
    settings: {max_iterations: 1}
orchestrator:
  name: Order desk
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Sales, Operations, Finance, CustomerSuccess]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: sales
        agent: Sales
        task: "Call sales_record with {}. Summarize the customer order and constraints. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: sales_record}
      - name: operations
        agent: Operations
        task: "Call operations_record with {}. Compare supply options with the requested delivery date and report the shortage. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: operations_record}
      - name: finance
        agent: Finance
        task: "Call finance_record with {}. Apply the policy tool. Relay its exact decision, price options and blockers. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: finance_record}
      - name: customer_reply
        agent: CustomerSuccess
        task: "Draft a short reply for the customer based on the Finance result. Omit all numerical details. On HOLD, ask whether timing or budget is flexible. Do not promise fulfillment or claim any purchase was made. /no_think"
